channel.title: The Grant Desk - next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: next 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: University of Oxford: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Computational Social Science and Text Analysis (CeDR)
item.description: Centre for Democratic Resilience, Department of Politics and International Relations, University of Oxford · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Salary GBP 39,424 to 51,983 per annum. Full-time, fixed-term for three years. No application fee.

item.title: The Grey Space in the Middle: State of States Open Call (The Hague)
item.description: The Grey Space in the Middle · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · EUR 375 artist fee per selected artist, plus up to EUR 725 additional for co-organising and participating in the context programme (up to EUR 1,100 total)

item.title: Algorave Istanbul: Open Call for New Artists and Performers
item.description: Algorave Istanbul · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · UNPAID, and no figure of any kind is published. The call states no fee, honorarium, stipend or expenses; it is an invitation to join a local live-coding community and perform with it. Listed here as a deliberate exception to the desk's paid-only rule because it is one of very few live-coding openings in the region. No application fee.

item.title: transmediale 2028: Open Call for Festival Curation
item.description: transmediale e.V. · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 40,000 net for an individual or EUR 50,000 net for a group, as a freelance contract covering December 2026 to March 2028 (ca. 70% commitment overall, full-time from October 2027). Possible contract extension for the 2029 edition, decided by the Advisory and Executive Board in summer 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Ann Arbor Film Festival 2027: Call for Entries (65th Edition)
item.description: Ann Arbor Film Festival · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · All selected artists receive a screening fee: USD 50 per short film, USD 100 per feature. Nearly USD 40,000 in total awards, including Oscar-qualifying prizes. Entry fee for the final deadline tier is USD 100 (the earlier USD 65 and USD 80 tiers have passed).

item.title: Making Space Residency 2027 for Netherlands-Based Practitioners (Guangzhou)
item.description: Making Space, in partnership with the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in China · deadline 03 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,700 travel and artist fee subsidy (fixed per application; duos or collectives share it), plus accommodation in Guangzhou and shared studio space

item.title: Welcome to my Homepage: Online Net Art Residency, Oulu Edition
item.description: The Museum of Human Achievement (MoHA), Austin, TX, with Oulu UNESCO City of Media Arts, Oulu Urban Culture and Frozen People · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 500 stipend, plus a user-friendly web builder (mmm.page), virtual studio visits and mentor conversations, promotion, a year-round showcase at welcometomyhomepage.net and a kiosk at the Austin Public Library's Innovate Lab, and in-person pop-up exhibitions at the Frozen People Festival in Oulu and at MoHA in Austin (Austin installation handled by the organisers; no resident travel funds to Austin). Free to apply.

item.title: Netflix x NALIP Director Incubator 2026-27 (short film grants)
item.description: NALIP (National Association of Latino Independent Producers) with Netflix · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 45,000 production grant for each of four selected directors to create an original narrative short film, plus individualized guidance, career development opportunities, and an industry showcase. No application fee, but current NALIP membership is required to apply.

item.title: Tech Policy Press Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Tech Policy Press · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend per fellow, paid quarterly. Also included: editorial guidance from the Tech Policy Press team, membership of an international cohort with regular feedback and exchange, and monthly sessions to strengthen the work. Fellows' work is published on the Tech Policy Press website and promoted through the newsletter, podcast and events. No application fee.

item.title: KTH Royal Institute of Technology: PhD, Feminist AI Addressing Gender-Based Violence
item.description: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Department of Computing and Learning Systems) · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · Fully funded, full-time employed doctoral position with monthly salary according to KTH's collectively agreed doctoral student salary agreement, plus Swedish employee benefits. No application fee.

item.title: CTM Festival: Resynthesising the Traditional 2027 Artistic Lab (At the Extreme)
item.description: CTM Festival, co-curated by Stas Sharifulla · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · Travel budget of up to EUR 300 per person, plus accommodation and catering for the duration of the lab and a festival pass to CTM 2027 events. Visa fees are supported where required, and letters of invitation are provided for visa or funding applications. NO artist fee or stipend for the lab itself. Afterwards, up to two new works arising from the lab may be commissioned and presented at CTM Festival in January/February 2028. No application fee.

item.title: AI ART AWARD: NEXT ART AI 2026
item.description: HOBAN Cultural Foundation · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Total prize pool of KRW 21,000,000 across 20 winners, paid after deduction of applicable taxes and public charges. Grand Prize KRW 5,000,000 (selected regardless of category); in each of the two categories, First Prize KRW 2,000,000, three Second Prizes of KRW 1,000,000 each, and five Honorable Finalist awards of KRW 500,000 each; plus a HOBAN Group President's Award of KRW 1,000,000. Winners also receive plaques and certificates, online and offline exhibition opportunities, and a feature on the official online platform. No entry fee is mentioned.

item.title: European Cultural Foundation: Academic Research Fellowship (ECF Historical Archives)
item.description: European Cultural Foundation, hosted at the Historical Archives of the European Union · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 grant to support a research stay at the HAEU, covering travel, accommodation and living expenses. The parallel Artistic Research Fellowship carries EUR 10,000 and additionally covers artistic production. No application fee.

item.title: Frameline Completion Fund 2027
item.description: Frameline · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Grants of up to USD 5,000, with a standard range of USD 1,000 to 5,000; the jury can recommend amounts above or below that range. No application fee.

item.title: SAT: Research-Creation Residency Program in Arts and Technologies 2026-28 (Montreal)
item.description: Societe des arts technologiques (SAT) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CAD 10,000 grant per selected project, for individual artists and collectives alike. Also included: access to SAT workspaces during the residency periods, access to equipment and software resources subject to availability, mentoring and training activities (on site and remote), creative and technical support from the SAT teams, and documentation and archiving of the work. Travel, meals and accommodation beyond the grant are NOT covered. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/

  • 2027 d/p Curator Support Open Call (Seoul)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1iSjEuCjay7DhL1AF1NCePu-5RV3t_10WT0CNcjNNJy8/preview
    d/p, sponsored by NakwonSangga · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Curatorial grant of KRW 4,000,000 (including tax) per selected curator or team, plus use of d/p's approximately 187 square metre exhibition space for a five-week exhibition and curatorial collaboration with the d/p team. Approximately two curators or teams are selected. No application fee.
  • Teatri Riflessi 2027: Short Performance Competition (12th edition)
    https://www.iterculture.eu/en/teatri-riflessi/tr2027/tr12/
    IterCulture APS · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Gross performance fee of EUR 500 to EUR 1,100 (VAT included) per selected short performance, scaled by the number of performers on stage, plus a possible travel contribution of up to EUR 250 subject to available funding, place of origin, cast size and absence of external touring grants. At least 10 performances are selected. Competition prizes: Best Performance EUR 1,200; Best Dramaturgy, Best Direction, Best Performer and the Scholars' and Critics' Award EUR 500 each; 'Valentina Nicosia' Fund EUR 500; 'Sandra Bressan' research fund EUR 1,800; Youth Jury Award EUR 300; plus non-cash awards (Audience Special Mention, Companies' Choice, Technical Crew). Panel members and Teatri Riflessi Network partners may also award special prizes in the form of artist residencies and touring opportunities. Application is free; selected companies pay a EUR 50 deposit that is fully refunded after the festival.

item.description:

item.title: 7 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung: Project Funding (October 2026 round)
    https://evs-musikstiftung.ch/en/project-funding/application/
    Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · No published minimum or maximum. Primarily covers artistic costs, not overheads. The Foundation explicitly will not fully fund a project, and requires at least one other institution to participate financially at a level similar to the amount requested, functioning as a de facto 1:1 match. No application fee.
  • Alicia Patterson Fellowship 2027 (Fund for Investigative Journalism)
    https://investigate.submittable.com/submit/355041/alicia-patterson-fellowship-2027
    Fund for Investigative Journalism (Alicia Patterson Foundation program) · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $40,000 (12-month fellowship) or $20,000 (6-month fellowship), paid monthly; covers living and reporting costs
  • Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.

    https://ideasimagination.columbia.edu/apply/applying-for-a-fellowship/

    https://www.berlin.de/sen/kultur/foerderung/antragsfristen/
    Berlin Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Work stipend for women film and video artists; the amount for this round is not yet confirmed (sibling Senate work stipends pay EUR 2,000 per month). No application fee.
  • Pandora Short Film Grant 2026
    https://pandora.org/
    Pandora Short Film Grant · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $12,000 production grant to the winner, plus a Panavision camera package (worth about $15,000), an optional $1,000 Kodak Film Grant toward film stock and lab expenses, mentorship from an award-winning filmmaker, and fiscal sponsorship. Three finalists receive mentorship, fiscal sponsorship, consideration for the Panavision New Filmmaker Program, and $500 off Athos production insurance. ENTRY FEE: tiered, $30 regular ($27 Gold members) and $40 late ($36); Pandora states fee waivers are available on request.
  • Slamdance Film Festival 2027: DIG (Digital, Interactive and Gaming)
    https://slamdance.com/festival-submit/
    Slamdance · deadline 06 Oct 2026 · Festival exhibition at Slamdance in Los Angeles. DIG welcomes interactive documentaries, VR/AR, experiential installations, and genre-bending games. Entry fees: USD 60 regular, USD 70 late, USD 90 extended/final.
  • Architecture Kick Start Grant Scheme

    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 07 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 total project budget including co-financing. Round budget EUR 167,000. Maximum 35 applications per period, ordered by random draw. No application fee.
